title: EOD, IA2 exploit unexploded ordnance | B-Roll
description: U.S. Marine Corps explosive ordnance disposal technicians with Marine Corps Installations Pacific and criminal investigation agents with 3rd Intelligence Battalion, III Marine Expeditionary Force Information Group exploit unexploded ordinance during Exercise Resolute Dragon 2025 on Camp Foster, Okinawa, Japan, Sept. 22, 2025. The Identity and Attribution Activities (IA2) section conducts full-spectrum biometrics, forensic exploitation, and weapons technical intelligence operations in support of III MEF operations in order to enhance the intelligence picture, support targeting operations, and deny the enemy anonymity. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Cpl. Maksim Masloboev)
